P1 promise_stage DIFF: .lacks[]: core \".note: Open, not yet fixed: a receiver whose accept of the deal is in a draw's past (so the draw lands where it is signed, folds.md Lands), who later declines it and later accepts it again. Her line for the thing starts at that first yes (One start), so each later block of hers held only as its header could name it (the text). The oracle lists the first such header and not a later one whose key it cannot place; the core starts her line at a later yes and lists only the later header. Both answer not_shown; only the ids in lacks differ. The fix is in both engines (start at the yes the draw landed on; list every later header of that key).
